text: Thornbury's board is a mix of internal executives and external members who don't live in this data daily. A deck that gets looked at for ten seconds needs a different formatting pass than a dashboard an Executive clicks through live.

Raw warehouse field names and full-precision currency are exactly right for a SQL query and exactly wrong for a board room. Renaming pills to plain language, rounding currency, and retitling worksheets with a real headline all make the deck read correctly at a glance.

Every number on this dashboard was already correct the moment Lesson 17 finished it. This lesson doesn't touch a single number — it's entirely about whether a board member walks away with the right conclusion after a brief look.
Next lesson publishes this finished, board-ready deck to Tableau Public, getting it in front of the Board for real.
